title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high- trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

  • Job Title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Customer Science Team)
  • Team Focus: Marketing and Sales decision-making; transforming customer behavior into measurable objectives (acquisition, conversion, retention, revenue optimization).
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Research, design, and develop ML, statistical, and causal models for Marketing/Sales (Propensity, Uplift, Attribution, Forecasting).
  • Translate business problems into objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Design feature representations for customer behavior and lifecycle dynamics.
  • Design/analyze experiments (A/B, A/A, geo tests, incrementality, diff-in-diff).
  • Build evaluation frameworks aligned to business outcomes (ROI, CAC, GMV/LTV).
  • Partner with Marketing/Sales to define success metrics and decision thresholds.
  • Own end-to-end ML lifecycle (data acquisition to monitoring).
  • Develop scalable code/services integrating with CRM and marketing platforms.
  • Communicate insights and business implications to stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior scientists and help establish Customer Science best practices.
  • Requirements: ( Computer Vision and emphasizes Causal Inference).




Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. title: Analytics Architect
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.
  • Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

  • Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).
  • Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor a team of data engineers.


Nice to have Skills:

  • Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Spark Streaming for processing real-time data streams.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates for infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.


Experience:

1. Demonstrated expertise of 12+ years in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks/Synapse notebooks and Azure Data Factory.

2. Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Delta tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

3. Experience in efficiently using Auto Loader and Delta Live tables for seamless data ingestion and transformation.

4. Proficiency in building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL.

5. Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.

6. Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

7. Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA JAVA PLENO & SENIOR
description:
Atualmente temos posições em aberto no nível Pleno & Sênior.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend utilizando Java/Kotlin e frameworks como Spring Boot

- Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful e integrações entre sistemas

- Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software, como SOLID, Clean Code e Design Patterns

- Trabalhar com mensageria e processamento assíncrono (ex: SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- Atuar em ambientes de cloud (AWS), contribuindo para soluções escaláveis e resilientes (S3, SQS & EKS)

- Realizar manutenção evolutiva e corretiva, identificando e resolvendo problemas de performance e estabilidade

- Escrever e manter testes unitários e de integração

- Colaborar com times de frontend, produto e QA para entrega contínua de valor

- Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua do time e da arquitetura


Requisitos e qualificações

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas

- Experiência sólida com programação orientada a objetos e desenvolvimento backend

- Conhecimento prático em Java/Kotlin e Spring Framework

- Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)

- Familiaridade com arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços

- Experiência com controle de versão (Git) e integração contínua (CI/CD)

- Conhecimento em APIs, autenticação e segurança (JWT, OAuth, etc.)

- Boa capacidade de comunicação, trabalho em equipe e autonomia

- Perfil proativo, com facilidade para aprendizado contínuo e resolução de problemas

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno (Fiscal)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.



Principais Responsabilidades:


- Análise, design e codificação de aplicativos voltados para entrega de obrigações fiscais, tais como: NF-e, CT-e, NFS-e, MDF-e, Reinf, etc.

- Participação ativa no ciclo de desenvolvimento, trabalhando com dinâmicas ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, inclusive com interfaces em times com diferentes tecnologias.

- Atuar integrado ao time, mantendo a aplicação como full-cycle, sendo responsável desde o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades a resolução de problemas em ambientes produtivos.

- Colaboração ativa com stakeholders internos e externos.

- Atuar com foco nos clientes para entender os requisitos do negócio e buscar liberações de valor.

- Participação ativa na manutenção das práticas, padrões e processos que permeiam os padrões de desenvolvimento e qualidade.

- Ser referência no apoio técnico aos recursos de menos senioridade, sempre validando os padrões com a gestão.




Requisitos Necessários:


- Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlacionadas.

- Experiência comprovada de 5 anos ou mais no desenvolvimento de aplicações em Java 11 (ou superior);

- Certificações em JAVA são considerados diferenciais;

- Experiencia em Jasper é considerado diferencial;

- Experiência com Integração de sistemas (SOAP, REST);

- Experiência com SQL (JDBC);

- Experiência com Git;

- Familiaridade com frameworks e métodos ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban.

- Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e habilidades de resolução de problemas;

- Desejável conhecimento de ferramentas da Atlassian (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence);

- Inglês Avançado (diferencial);

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER (REMOTE)


About:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary :


Position Description

This is a remote working opportunity and you can work anywhere as long as you have a strong internet connection and the discipline to work alone. You will be working closely with other DevOPS engineers, software engineers and contributors on the project.


Responsibilities

  • Building and setting up new development tools and infrastructure
  • Understanding the needs of stakeholders and conveying this to developers
  • Working on ways to automate and improve development and release processes
  • Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats
  • Identifying technical problems and developing software updates and ‘fixes’
  • Working with software developers and software engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency
  • 5+ years experience as DevOPS/SRE at AWS environment
  • Exceptional leadership, time management, facilitation, and organizational skills


Must-Have Technologies

  • ELK Stack
  • Ansible
  • Grafana
  • Terraform
  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Fastly


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Back End Java/Kotlin - SR
description:
Código da vaga: 57220


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Desenvolvedor(a) Back End Java/Kotlin - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.


What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud


Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.


Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.


Location

Fully Remote position.


Job Details

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud


Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Fully Remote position.

Employee Group: Temporary

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node.js Sênior
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que estamos Buscando?

Desenvolvedor Back-End para participar da refatoração de demandas estruturais, com foco na revisão de processos e sistemas de integração e disponibilização de dados, desenvolvendo a solução tecnológica considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e monitoria. Atender as necessidades das áreas de negócios, observando os padrões e as diretivas corporativas. Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações. Ter atitude de dono, aplicando visão forense e buscando as melhores práticas com foco nos resultados e entregas. Levantar estimativas para as soluções propostas, com bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização, proatividade e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e desenvolvimento em NodeJs (JavaScript, desejável TypeScript), com testes unitários e de integração e documentação de APIs REST e Async API.

• Atuação no desenvolvimento de microsserviços, arquiteturas orientadas a serviços e eventos (SOA/EDA), com implementação de tracing, logging, containers e CI/CD.

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, versionamento de código, NPM/Yarn e metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban).

• Experiência em sustentação de aplicações, monitoria, troubleshooting, melhoria contínua e repasse para equipes de suporte.

• Diferencial para Java (Spring Boot e Spring Batch), Scala, Python, Kubernetes, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus, SQS) e protocolos HTTP/HTTPS, AMQP e TCP.

• Vivência com segurança da informação (LGPD/GDPR), ambientes financeiros, SaaS/DaaS, integração de dados e ferramentas de transferência de arquivos.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!


Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience


Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores.

28 anos de história e 16x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW).

Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um(a) SRE nível especialista para estar alocado em um dos nossos grandes clientes! Aquele profissional \"referência\", que resolve, estrutura e eleva o nível de confiabilidade de ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade em escala global.

Se você gosta de desafios reais, ambientes complexos, alta responsabilidade e impacto direto no negócio, essa vaga é para você!


Remoto – residindo no Brasil - 6 a 12 meses de duração

Atuação diária com time e stakeholders nos EUA


O propósito da posição

Garantir confiabilidade, escalabilidade e performance de sistemas críticos, atuando na ponte entre desenvolvimento e operações, aplicando princípios de engenharia de software para resolver desafios de infraestrutura e operação.
